verdict.rationale: Foreloop has its own API key system. Keys are created in Settings → Connections → API keys, and the docs recommend one key per integration so each can be revoked on its own. A "write-only key" for the feedback widget shows that keys can carry different privilege levels. However, there is no documentation of choosing scopes or permissions for keys given to agents or MCP clients. Missing for 10: documented scope or permission selection when creating agent and MCP keys, project- or repo-level restriction of keys, and independent or hands-on confirmation of least-privilege enforcement.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Give every integration its own key, so revoking one does not take down the others.
An MCP client needs that URL and an API key and nothing else.
